rainfall_lag_reason: Historical Pass 2 nominal latency was 120 minutes; use 3 hours including processing margin. Actual historic arrival times are unavailable; evaluation remains retrospective.
split_boundary_policy: Seven-day gaps separate splits; additionally inspect rainfall events crossing each gap before freezing evaluation.
training_sampling_policy: Retain all eligible positives; deterministically sample negatives and store inverse inclusion weights. Never apply this sampling to validation or test.
evaluation_storage: Keep normalized street, rainfall, and sparse label tables; stream complete eligible validation/test rows by day instead of materializing billions of rows.
